sanskrit: ayā vītī pari srava yas ta indo madeṣv ā avāhan navatīr nava
english: Flow around with this enjoyment, O Indu, who in thy raptures hast slain ninety-nine foes.

sanskrit: puraḥ sadya itthādhiye divodāsāya śambaram adha tyaṁ turvaśaṁ yadum
english: Forthwith, for Divodāsa who reflects even thus, thou didst smite Śambara; and Turvaśa, and Yadu.

sanskrit: pari ṇo aśvam aśvavid gomad indo hiraṇyavat kṣarā sahasriṇīr iṣaḥ
english: Flow around us, O Indu, thou who knowest horses, with nourishment rich in kine, in gold, in steeds, thousandfold.

sanskrit: pavamānasya te vayam pavitram abhyundataḥ sakhitvam ā vṛṇīmahe
english: We choose the friendship of thee, Pavamāna, whose filter is sprinkled all about.

sanskrit: ye te pavitram ūrmayo 'bhikṣaranti dhārayā tebhir naḥ soma mṛḻaya
english: With those waves of thine, O Soma, that flow over the filter in a stream, be gracious unto us.

sanskrit: sa naḥ punāna ā bhara rayiṁ vīravatīm iṣam īśānaḥ soma viśvataḥ
english: Do thou, purifying thyself, O Soma, bring to us wealth rich in hero-sons and food, thou who art lord of all.

sanskrit: etam u tyaṁ daśa kṣipo mṛjanti sindhumātaram sam ādityebhir akhyata
english: Ten fingers cleanse this very Soma, the river-born, who has been viewed together with the Ādityas.

sanskrit: sam indreṇota vāyunā suta eti pavitra ā saṁ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ
english: Pressed, he flows through the filter together with Indra, together with Vāyu, together with the rays of the Sun.

sanskrit: sa no bhagāya vāyave pūṣṇe pavasva madhumān cārur mitre varuṇe ca
english: Flow for us, O sweet one, lovely for Bhaga, for Vāyu, for Pūṣan, for Mitra and Varuṇa.

sanskrit: uccā te jātam andhaso divi ṣad bhūmy ā dade ugraṁ śarma mahi śravaḥ
english: The exalted birth of thy exhilarating juice is placed on high in heaven and on earth — mighty shelter, great glory.

sanskrit: enā viśvāny arya ā dyumnāni mānuṣāṇām siṣāsanto vanāmahe
english: Through this, O noble one, desiring to win all the glories of mankind, we praise thee.

sanskrit: sa na indrāya yajyave varuṇāya marudbhyaḥ varivovit pari srava
english: Flow around, for us, for worshipful Indra, for Varuṇa, for the Maruts — thou who knowest wide space.

sanskrit: upo ṣu jātam apturaṁ gobhir bhaṅgam pariṣkṛtam induṁ devā ayāsiṣuḥ
english: The gods have come near to this Indu, the swift-moving one newly born, adorned and decked with cows.

sanskrit: tam id vardhantu no giro vatsaṁ saṁśiśvarīr iva ya indrasya hṛdaṁsaniḥ
english: May our hymns strengthen him — as mother cows lowing around their calf — him who gladdens Indra's heart.

sanskrit: arṣā ṇaḥ soma śaṁ gave dhukṣasva pipyuṣīm iṣam vardhā samudram ukthyam
english: Flow to us, O Soma, blissful for the cow; milk out for us fattening nourishment; increase the hymn-worthy ocean.

sanskrit: pavamāno ajījanad divaś citraṁ na tanyatum jyotir vaiśvānaram bṛhat
english: Pavamāna has generated the great Vaiśvānara light, wondrous like the thunder of heaven.

sanskrit: pavamānasya te raso mado rājann aducchunaḥ vi vāram avyam arṣati
english: Thy juice, the exhilaration of thee Pavamāna, O King, unerring, flows forth through the woollen filter.

sanskrit: pavamāna rasas tava dakṣo vi rājati dyumān jyotir viśvaṁ svar dṛśe
english: O Pavamāna, thy vigorous juice shines brilliantly — the universal light, the sun, to be seen.

sanskrit: yas te mado vareṇyas tenā pavasvāndhasā devāvīr aghaśaṁsahā
english: With that excellent rapture of thine, O Soma, flow through thy juice, a friend to the gods, a slayer of the wicked.

sanskrit: jaghnir vṛtram amitriyaṁ sasnir vājaṁ dive-dive goṣā u aśvasā asi
english: Thou art the slayer of the hostile Vṛtra, the winner of prizes day after day; thou art the finder of cows and horses.

sanskrit: sammiślo aruṣo bhava sūpasthābhir na dhenubhiḥ sīdañ chyeno na yonim ā
english: Be thou commingled, O tawny one, like cows with fair udders, sitting down like a hawk into the vessel.

sanskrit: sa pavasva ya āvithendraṁ vṛtrāya hantave vavrivāṁsam mahīr apaḥ
english: Do thou flow pure, thou who hast aided Indra to slay Vṛtra who had covered the great waters.

sanskrit: suvīrāso vayaṁ dhanā jayema soma mīḍhvaḥ punāno vardha no giraḥ
english: Provided with good heroes, may we win wealth, O liberal Soma; purifying thyself, magnify our hymns.

sanskrit: tvotāsas tavāvasā syāma vanvanta āmuraḥ soma vrateṣu jāgṛhi
english: May we, who gain under thy protection and shelter, be active and eager; O Soma, be wakeful in thy rites.

sanskrit: apaghnan pavate mṛdho 'pa somo arāvṇaḥ gacchann indrasya niṣkṛtam
english: Soma flows, smiting away enemies, driving off the niggardly, going to Indra's place of purification.

sanskrit: maho no rāya ā bhara pavamāna jahī mṛdhaḥ rāsvendo vīravad yaśaḥ
english: Bring us great riches, O Pavamāna; smite our foes; O Indu, grant us glory rich in hero-sons.

sanskrit: na tvā śataṁ cana hruto rādho ditsantam ā minan yat punāno makhasyase
english: Not even a hundred deceivers can obstruct the bounty thou willest to bestow, when purifying thyself thou art bountiful.

sanskrit: pavasvendo vṛṣā sutaḥ kṛdhī no yaśaso jane viśvā apa dviṣo jahi
english: Flow pure, O Indu, pressed and virile; make us glorious among men; smite away all enemies.

sanskrit: asya te sakhye vayaṁ tavendo dyumna uttame sāsahyāma pṛtanyataḥ
english: In thy friendship, O Indu, in thy supreme splendour, may we overcome those who fight against us.

sanskrit: yā te bhīmāny āyudhā tigmāni santi dhūrvaṇe rakṣā samasya no nidaḥ
english: Thy terrible, sharp weapons that are for the harm of the oppressor — guard us with them wholly from those who blame us.

sanskrit: ete asṛgram indavas tiraḥ pavitram āśavaḥ viśvāny abhi saubhagā
english: These swift Indu-drops have been poured forth through the filter, going toward all prosperities.

sanskrit: vighnanto duritā puru sugā tokāya vājinaḥ tanā kṛṇvanto arvate
english: Clearing away many evils, opening easy paths, the vigorous drops create good progeny for offspring and the coursing steed.

sanskrit: kṛṇvanto varivo gave 'bhy arṣanti suṣṭutim iḻām asmabhyaṁ saṁyatam
english: Making wide space for the cow, they flow toward excellent praise and toward Iḻā assembled together for us.

sanskrit: asāvy aṁśur madāyāpsu dakṣo giriṣṭhāḥ śyeno na yonim āsadat
english: The stalk has been pressed for exhilaration; his vigour dwelling in the mountains and the waters — like a hawk he has settled in his seat.

sanskrit: śubhram andho devavātam apsu dhūto nṛbhiḥ sutaḥ svadanti gāvaḥ payobhiḥ
english: The bright food, desired by the gods, purified in the waters, pressed by men — the cows make it savory with their milk.

sanskrit: ād īm aśvaṁ na hetāro 'śūśubhann amṛtāya madhvo rasaṁ sadhamāde
english: Then, like those who urge a horse, they have adorned him for immortality, the juice of the sweet drink at the common festival.

sanskrit: yās te dhārā madhuścuto 'sṛgram inda ūtaye tābhiḥ pavitram āsadaḥ
english: Those honey-dripping streams of thine, O Indu, that have been poured forth for our help — with them thou hast settled on the filter.

sanskrit: so arṣendrāya pītaye tiro romāṇy avyayā sīdan yonā vaneṣv ā
english: He flows for Indra to drink, through the undying woollen hairs, settling into his vessel in the wood.

sanskrit: tvam indo pari srava svādiṣṭho aṅgirobhyaḥ varivovid ghṛtam payaḥ
english: Do thou, O Indu, flow around, most sweet for the Aṅgirases, thou who knowest wide space — milk and ghee.

sanskrit: ayaṁ vicarṣaṇir hitaḥ pavamānaḥ sa cetati hinvāna āpyam bṛhat
english: This Pavamāna, the all-seeing, placed here, grows wise; urged on, he impels the great watery ocean.

sanskrit: eṣa vṛṣā vṛṣavrataḥ pavamāno aśastihā karad vasūni dāśuṣe
english: This vigorous Pavamāna, of vigorous vows, the destroyer of revilers, shall bestow riches on the worshipper.

sanskrit: ā pavasva sahasriṇaṁ rayiṁ gomantam aśvinam puruścandram puruspṛham
english: Flow to us with thousandfold wealth, with cattle, with horses, with many splendours, much longed for.

sanskrit: eṣa sya pari ṣicyate marmṛjyamāna āyubhiḥ urugāyaḥ kavikratuḥ
english: This one is poured around, being well-cleansed by the living ones — far-ranging, of sage-wisdom.

sanskrit: sahasrotiḥ śatāmagho vimāno rajasaḥ kaviḥ indrāya pavate madaḥ
english: He of a thousand streams, of a hundredfold gifts, the measurer of the firmament, the sage — this exhilaration flows for Indra.

sanskrit: girā jāta iha stuta indur indrāya dhīyate vir yonā vasatāv iva
english: Indu, born by the hymn, here praised, is placed for Indra — he fills the vessel as it were a dwelling-place.

sanskrit: pavamānaḥ suto nṛbhiḥ somo vājam ivāsarat camūṣu śakmanāsadam
english: Pavamāna Soma, pressed out by men, has run forth like a prize-winner, seating himself by his power in the bowls.

sanskrit: taṁ tripṛṣṭhe trivandhure rathe yuñjanti yātave ṛṣīṇāṁ sapta dhītibhiḥ
english: They yoke him to travel in the triple-backed, triple-fellied chariot, with the seven thoughts of the seers.

sanskrit: taṁ sotāro dhanaspṛtam āśuṁ vājāya yātave hariṁ hinota vājinam
english: Speed him, the pressers, the touch-prize swift one, the tawny vigorous one, for travel and for the prize.

sanskrit: āviśan kalaśaṁ suto viśvā arṣann abhi śriyaḥ śūro na goṣu tiṣṭhati
english: Entering the vessel when pressed, flowing around all glories, he stands like a hero among the cows.

sanskrit: ā ta indo madāya kam payo duhanty āyavaḥ devā devebhyo madhu
english: For thy exhilaration, O Indu, the living ones milk out the milk; the gods bring sweetness for the gods.

sanskrit: ā naḥ somam pavitra ā sṛjatā madhumattamam devebhyo devaśruttamam
english: Release Soma into the filter for us, most honey-sweet, most renowned among the gods for the gods.

sanskrit: ete somā asṛkṣata gṛṇānāḥ śravase mahe madintamasya dhārayā
english: These Somas have been poured forth, praised with the stream of him most exhilarating, for great glory.

sanskrit: abhi gavyāni vītaye nṛmṇā punāno arṣasi sanadvājaḥ pari srava
english: Toward the cow-wealth for enjoyment, toward manly powers, thou purifiest thyself and flowest; O ever-prize-winner, flow around.

sanskrit: uta no gomatīr iṣo viśvā arṣa pariṣṭubhaḥ gṛṇāno jamadagninā
english: And flow to us with all nourishments rich in cows, with sounds everywhere resounding, praised by Jamadagni.

sanskrit: pavasva vāco agriyaḥ soma citrābhir ūtibhiḥ abhi viśvāni kāvyā
english: Flow pure, O Soma, foremost of utterances, with variegated aids, encompassing all poetic wisdom.

sanskrit: tvaṁ samudriyā apo 'griyo vāca īrayan pavasva viśvamejaya
english: Thou foremost of the oceanic waters, stirring the hymns, flow purified, O mover of the universe.

sanskrit: tubhyemā bhuvanā kave mahimne soma tasthire tubhyam arṣanti sindhavaḥ
english: These worlds, O sage Soma, stand for thy greatness; toward thee flow the rivers.

sanskrit: pra te divo na vṛṣṭayo dhārā yanty asaścataḥ abhi śukrām upastiram
english: Thy streams go forth unceasing like rains from heaven, over the bright strewn grass.

sanskrit: indrāyendum punītanograṁ dakṣāya sādhanam īśānaṁ vītirādhasam
english: Purify for Indra this fierce Indu, the instrument of the mighty one, the lord, the bestower of boons.

sanskrit: pavamāna ṛtaḥ kaviḥ somaḥ pavitram āsadat dadhat stotre suvīryam
english: Pavamāna, the true, the sage, Soma, has settled on the filter, bestowing heroic might upon the praiser.

sanskrit: ā pavasva sahasriṇaṁ rayiṁ soma suvīryam asme śravāṁsi dhāraya
english: Flow to us, O Soma, with thousandfold wealth and heroic strength; pour upon us glories.

sanskrit: iṣam ūrjaṁ ca pinvasa indrāya matsarintamaḥ camūṣv ā ni ṣīdasi
english: Thou dost swell with food and vigour, most exhilarating for Indra; thou sittest down in the bowls.

sanskrit: suta indrāya viṣṇave somaḥ kalaśe akṣarat madhumām astu vāyave
english: Soma, pressed out for Indra, for Viṣṇu, flows into the vessel; may he be sweet for Vāyu.

sanskrit: ete asṛgram āśavo 'ti hvarāṁsi babhravaḥ somā ṛtasya dhārayā
english: These swift tawny Soma-drops have been poured, crossing over the crooked places by the stream of truth.

sanskrit: indraṁ vardhanto apturaḥ kṛṇvanto viśvam āryam apaghnanto arāvṇaḥ
english: They who increase Indra, the swift-moving ones, making all things noble, smiting away the niggardly.

sanskrit: sutā anu svam ā rajo 'bhy arṣanti babhravaḥ indraṁ gacchanta indavaḥ
english: The tawny Indus, pressed out, flowing toward their own domain, the drops of Soma go to Indra.

sanskrit: ayā pavasva dhārayā yayā sūryam arocayaḥ hinvāno mānuṣīr apaḥ
english: Flow with that stream by which thou didst make the sun to shine, urging on the human waters.

sanskrit: ayukta sūra etaśam pavamāno manāv adhi antarikṣeṇa yātave
english: Pavamāna yoked the dapple steed upon Manu, to travel through the atmosphere.

sanskrit: uta tyā harito daśa sūro ayukta yātave indur indra iti bruvan
english: Indu yoked also those ten tawny mares of the sun to travel, saying 'Indra'.

sanskrit: parīto vāyave sutaṁ gira indrāya matsaram avyo vāreṣu siñcata
english: Pour around the pressed, exhilarating juice with hymns for Vāyu and Indra into the woollen strainers.

sanskrit: pavamāna vidā rayim asmabhyaṁ soma duṣṭaram yo dūṇāśo vanuṣyatā
english: O Pavamāna Soma, find for us the irresistible wealth — that which is not to be consumed by the assailant.

sanskrit: abhy arṣa sahasriṇaṁ rayiṁ gomantam aśvinam abhi vājam uta śravaḥ
english: Flow toward thousandfold wealth with cattle, with horses, toward the prize and glory.

sanskrit: somo devo na sūryo 'dribhiḥ pavate sutaḥ dadhānaḥ kalaśe rasam
english: Soma the god, like the sun, is purified by the stones when pressed, holding his juice in the vessel.

sanskrit: ete dhāmāny āryā śukrā ṛtasya dhārayā vājaṁ gomantam akṣaran
english: These bright, noble abodes have flowed with the stream of truth toward the prize rich in cattle.

sanskrit: sutā indrāya vajriṇe somāso dadhyāśiraḥ pavitram aty akṣaran
english: Soma-drops pressed for Indra the thunderer, mixed with curd, have flowed beyond the filter.

sanskrit: pra soma madhumattamo rāye arṣa pavitra ā mado yo devavītamaḥ
english: Flow forth, O Soma most honey-sweet, through the filter toward wealth, O exhilaration most beloved by the gods.

sanskrit: tam ī mṛjanty āyavo hariṁ nadīṣu vājinam indum indrāya matsaram
english: The living ones cleanse him, the tawny prize-winning Indu, in the streams, the exhilarant for Indra.

sanskrit: ā pavasva hiraṇyavad aśvāvat soma vīravat vājaṁ gomantam ā bhara
english: Flow purified, O Soma, with gold, with horses, with heroes; bring us the prize rich in kine.

sanskrit: pari vāje na vājayum avyo vāreṣu siñcata indrāya madhumattamam
english: As one who wins prizes, pour the most honey-sweet one into the woollen strainers for Indra, around the prize.

sanskrit: kavim mṛjanti marjyaṁ dhībhir viprā avasyavaḥ vṛṣā kanikrad arṣati
english: The wise, seeking help, cleanse the sage, the one worthy of cleansing, with their thoughts; the vigorous one flows bellowing.

sanskrit: vṛṣaṇaṁ dhībhir apturaṁ somam ṛtasya dhārayā matī viprāḥ sam asvaran
english: The inspired sages have sung together with thoughts and the stream of truth about the vigorous, swift-moving Soma.

sanskrit: pavasva devāyuṣag indraṁ gacchatu te madaḥ vāyum ā roha dharmaṇā
english: Flow purified, O god-life-prolonger; let thy exhilaration go to Indra; mount upon Vāyu according to thy ordinance.

sanskrit: pavamāna ni tośase rayiṁ soma śravāyyam priyaḥ samudram ā viśa
english: O Pavamāna Soma, thou dost pour out wealth worthy of renown; beloved, enter the ocean.

sanskrit: apaghnan pavase mṛdhaḥ kratuvit soma matsaraḥ nudasvādevayuṁ janam
english: Flowing, thou smitest enemies, O Soma the exhilarant who knowest purpose; push away the godless folk.

sanskrit: pavamānā asṛkṣata somāḥ śukrāsa indavaḥ abhi viśvāni kāvyā
english: The Pavamāna Soma-drops, bright Indus, have been poured forth encompassing all poetic wisdom.

sanskrit: pavamānāsa āśavaḥ śubhrā asṛgram indavaḥ ghnanto viśvā apa dviṣaḥ
english: The swift, bright Pavamāna Indus have been poured forth, smiting away all adversaries.

sanskrit: pavamānā divas pary antarikṣād asṛkṣata pṛthivyā adhi sānavi
english: The Pavamānas have been poured from heaven, from the atmosphere, from above the earth upon the ridge.

sanskrit: punānaḥ soma dhārayendo viśvā apa sridhaḥ jahi rakṣāṁsi sukrato
english: Purifying thyself, O Soma, with thy stream, O Indu, drive away all failures; slay the demons, O excellent in purpose.

sanskrit: apaghnan soma rakṣaso 'bhy arṣa kanikradat dyumantaṁ śuṣmam uttamam
english: Smiting the demons, O Soma, flow forth bellowing, with thy loftiest brilliant vigour.

sanskrit: asme vasūni dhāraya soma divyāni pārthivā indo viśvāni vāryā
english: Pour upon us riches heavenly and earthly, O Soma, O Indu — all desirable things.

sanskrit: vṛṣā soma dyumām asi vṛṣā deva vṛṣavrataḥ vṛṣā dharmāṇi dadhiṣe
english: Thou art a vigorous bull, O Soma, full of brilliance; O god, a bull of virile vows; a bull thou holdest thy ordinances.

sanskrit: vṛṣṇas te vṛṣṇyaṁ śavo vṛṣā vanaṁ vṛṣā madaḥ satyaṁ vṛṣan vṛṣed asi
english: Thy virile strength is the strength of a bull; virile is thy love, virile thy exhilaration — truly, O bull, thou art a bull indeed.

sanskrit: aśvo na cakrado vṛṣā saṁ gā indo sam arvataḥ vi no rāye duro vṛdhi
english: Like a neighing stallion, O vigorous Indu, join the cows to us, join the steeds; open wide the doors of wealth for us.

sanskrit: asṛkṣata pra vājino gavyā somāso aśvayā śukrāso vīrayāśavaḥ
english: The vigorous, bright, swift Soma-drops have been poured forth striving for cattle and horses and heroes.

sanskrit: śumbhamānā ṛtāyubhir mṛjyamānā gabhastyoḥ pavante vāre avyaye
english: Adorning themselves, being cleansed by the life-giving forces of truth by the hands of men, they flow through the undying woollen filter.

sanskrit: te viśvā dāśuṣe vasu somā divyāni pārthivā pavantām āntarikṣyā
english: May those Somas — heavenly, earthly, and atmospheric — flow purified bringing all wealth to the worshipper.

sanskrit: pavamānasya viśvavit pra te sargā asṛkṣata sūryasyeva na raśmayaḥ
english: O all-knowing Pavamāna, thy streams have been poured forth like the rays of the sun.

sanskrit: ketuṁ kṛṇvan divas pari viśvā rūpābhy arṣasi samudraḥ soma pinvase
english: Making a banner over the sky, thou flowest around all forms; O Soma, thou swellest as the ocean.

sanskrit: hinvāno vācam iṣyasi pavamāna vidharmaṇi akrān devo na sūryaḥ
english: Being urged on, thou impellest the hymn, O Pavamāna, in the course of thy ordinance; like the sun-god thou hast stepped forth.

sanskrit: induḥ paviṣṭa cetanaḥ priyaḥ kavīnām matī sṛjad aśvaṁ rathīr iva
english: Indu, the wise, beloved of sages, has entered the filter, releasing the steed with his thought like a charioteer.

sanskrit: ūrmir yas te pavitra ā devāvīḥ paryakṣarat sīdann ṛtasya yonim ā
english: Thy wave which, dear to gods, flows around through the filter, settling into the womb of truth.

sanskrit: sa no arṣa pavitra ā mado yo devavītamaḥ indav indrāya pītaye
english: Let that exhilaration, most beloved by the gods, flow to us through the filter, O Indu, for Indra to drink.

sanskrit: iṣe pavasva dhārayā mṛjyamāno manīṣibhiḥ indo rucābhi gā ihi
english: Flow for nourishment, O Indu, with thy stream, being cleansed by the wise; go with thy radiances to the cows.

sanskrit: punāno varivas kṛdhy ūrjaṁ janāya girvaṇaḥ hare sṛjāna āśiram
english: Purifying thyself, O lover of song, create wide space and vigour for the people; O tawny one, releasing the mixed drink.

sanskrit: punāno devavītaya indrasya yāhi niṣkṛtam dyutāno vājibhir yataḥ
english: Purifying thyself for the delight of gods, go to Indra's place of purification, flashing with thy prize-winning steeds.

sanskrit: pra hinvānāsa indavo 'cchā samudram āśavaḥ dhiyā jūtā asṛkṣata
english: The swift Indus, being urged forward, sped toward the ocean, impelled by thought, poured forth.

sanskrit: marmṛjānāsa āyavo vṛthā samudram indavaḥ agmann ṛtasya yonim ā
english: The Indus, being well cleansed by the living ones, have freely gone to the ocean, entered the womb of truth.

sanskrit: pari ṇo yāhy asmayur viśvā vasūny ojasā pāhi naḥ śarma vīravat
english: Go around us, O thou who desirest us, with all riches by thy might; protect us with shelter rich in heroes.

sanskrit: mimāti vahnir etaśaḥ padaṁ yujāna ṛkvabhiḥ pra yat samudra āhitaḥ
english: The carrier-steed lows, as one who yokes himself with singers, when Soma is poured into the ocean.

sanskrit: ā yad yoniṁ hiraṇyayam āśur ṛtasya sīdati jahāty apracetasaḥ
english: When the swift one settles into the golden womb of truth, he abandons the unwise.

sanskrit: abhi venā anūṣateyakṣanti pracetasaḥ majjanty avicetasaḥ
english: The wise ones, the discerning, follow the streams and sing beside them; the foolish are submerged.

sanskrit: indrāyendo marutvate pavasva madhumattamaḥ ṛtasya yonim āsadam
english: O Indu, flow purified, most honey-sweet, for Indra with his Marut-host; settle in the womb of truth.

sanskrit: taṁ tvā viprā vacovidaḥ pari ṣkṛṇvanti vedhasaḥ saṁ tvā mṛjanty āyavaḥ
english: The inspired, wise, sapient ones adorn thee on all sides; the living ones cleanse thee together.

sanskrit: rasaṁ te mitro aryamā pibanti varuṇaḥ kave pavamānasya marutaḥ
english: O sage, Mitra, Aryaman, Varuṇa, and the Maruts drink the juice of thee the Pavamāna.

sanskrit: tvaṁ soma vipaścitam punāno vācam iṣyasi indo sahasrabharṇasam
english: Thou, O Soma, O Indu, purifying thyself, dost impel the wise speech of thousandfold bounty.

sanskrit: uto sahasrabharṇasaṁ vācaṁ soma makhasyuvam punāna indav ā bhara
english: And bring to us, O Soma, O Indu, purifying thyself, the speech of thousandfold bounty, eager for sacrifice.

sanskrit: punāna indav eṣām puruhūta janānām priyaḥ samudram ā viśa
english: Purifying thyself, O Indu, beloved of these widely invoked peoples, enter the ocean.

sanskrit: davidyutatyā rucā pariṣṭobhantyā kṛpā somāḥ śukrā gavāśiraḥ
english: With flashing, all-resounding radiance and with grace, the bright Soma-drops, blended with milk, shine forth.

sanskrit: hinvāno hetṛbhir yata ā vājaṁ vājy akramīt sīdanto vanuṣo yathā
english: Urged on, guided by the urgers, the vigorous prize-winner has stepped toward the prize, the drops settling like eager ones.

sanskrit: ṛdhak soma svastaye saṁjagmāno divaḥ kaviḥ pavasva sūryo dṛśe
english: O Soma, flowing separately for well-being, the sage who comes together from heaven, flow purified to be seen as the sun.

sanskrit: hinvanti sūram usrayaḥ svasāro jāmayas patim mahām indum mahīyuvaḥ
english: The dawn-rays, like sisters of the same kin, urge on the great Indu, their lord, the mighty ones delighting in greatness.

sanskrit: pavamāna rucā-rucā devo devebhyas pari viśvā vasūny ā viśa
english: O Pavamāna, with brilliance upon brilliance, O god, enter all riches from the gods.

sanskrit: ā pavamāna suṣṭutiṁ vṛṣṭiṁ devebhyo duvaḥ iṣe pavasva saṁyatam
english: O Pavamāna, bring us excellent praise, service to the gods, rain; flow purified, concentrated, for nourishment.

sanskrit: vṛṣā hy asi bhānunā dyumantaṁ tvā havāmahe pavamāna svādhyaḥ
english: For thou art a vigorous bull with thy radiance; thee the brilliant one we invoke, O Pavamāna, excellent in thought.

sanskrit: ā pavasva suvīryam mandamānaḥ svāyudha iho ṣv indav ā gahi
english: Flow purified with heroic strength, rejoicing, O thou whose weapons are good; come here, O Indu, come.

sanskrit: yad adbhiḥ pariṣicyase mṛjyamāno gabhastyoḥ druṇā sadhastham aśnuṣe
english: When thou art sprinkled around with the waters, being cleansed by the hands, thou attainest the common seat in the wood.

sanskrit: pra somāya vyaśvavat pavamānāya gāyata mahe sahasracakṣase
english: Sing forth to Pavamāna Soma, like Vyaśva, to the great one of a thousand eyes.

sanskrit: yasya varṇam madhuścutaṁ hariṁ hinvanty adribhiḥ indum indrāya pītaye
english: They urge on with the stones the honey-dripping, tawny Indu whose colour gleams, for Indra to drink.

sanskrit: tasya te vājino vayaṁ viśvā dhanāni jigyuṣaḥ sakhitvam ā vṛṇīmahe
english: We, having won all the riches of thee the vigorous prize-winner, choose thy friendship.

sanskrit: vṛṣā pavasva dhārayā marutvate ca matsaraḥ viśvā dadhāna ojasā
english: Flow purified, O vigorous bull, with thy stream, O exhilarant, for him with his Maruts, bearing all things with strength.

sanskrit: taṁ tvā dhartāram oṇyo3ḥ pavamāna svardṛśam hinve vājeṣu vājinam
english: I urge thee on, O Pavamāna, the sustainer of the well, the beholder of heaven, the prize-winning one in the contests.

sanskrit: ayā citto vipānayā hariḥ pavasva dhārayā yujaṁ vājeṣu codaya
english: With this flowing, wise stream, O tawny one, flow purified; urge on the yoke-fellow in the prizes.

sanskrit: ā na indo mahīm iṣam pavasva viśvadarśataḥ asmabhyaṁ soma gātuvit
english: Flow to us, O Indu, with great nourishment, thou the all-beautiful; O Soma, thou who knowest the way to us.

sanskrit: ā kalaśā anūṣatendo dhārābhir ojasā endrasya pītaye viśa
english: The vessels have resounded, O Indu; with thy streams and strength, enter for Indra to drink.

sanskrit: yasya te madyaṁ rasaṁ tīvraṁ duhanty adribhiḥ sa pavasvābhimātihā
english: He whose pungent, exhilarating juice they milk out with the stones — flow pure, thou destroyer of assailants.

sanskrit: rājā medhābhir īyate pavamāno manāv adhi antarikṣeṇa yātave
english: The King Pavamāna travels with his wisdom upon Manu, to journey through the atmosphere.

sanskrit: ā na indo śatagvinaṁ gavām poṣaṁ svaśvyam vahā bhagattim ūtaye
english: Bring to us, O Indu, the prosperity of a hundred cows, the possession of good horses; bring good fortune as an aid.

sanskrit: ā naḥ soma saho juvo rūpaṁ na varcase bhara suṣvāṇo devavītaye
english: Bring to us, O Soma, pressed out for the delight of gods, strength and swiftness as form for brightness.

sanskrit: arṣā soma dyumattamo 'bhi droṇāni roruvat sīdañ chyeno na yonim ā
english: Flow, O Soma, most brilliant, roaring over the troughs, settling like a hawk into thy vessel.

sanskrit: apsā indrāya vāyave varuṇāya marudbhyaḥ somo arṣati viṣṇave
english: Soma flows swiftly for Indra, for Vāyu, for Varuṇa, for the Maruts, for Viṣṇu.

sanskrit: iṣaṁ tokāya no dadhad asmabhyaṁ soma viśvataḥ ā pavasva sahasriṇam
english: Bestowing nourishment on our offspring, O Soma, from all sides, flow purified, thousandfold.

sanskrit: ye somāsaḥ parāvati ye arvāvati sunvire ye vādaḥ śaryaṇāvati
english: Those Soma-drops that are pressed in the distant region, those pressed in the near region, those pressed at the Śaryaṇāvat lake —

sanskrit: ya ārjīkeṣu kṛtvasu ye madhye pastyānām ye vā janeṣu pañcasu
english: Those among the Ārjīkas, among the active ones, those in the midst of the homesteads, or those among the five peoples —

sanskrit: te no vṛṣṭiṁ divas pari pavantām ā suvīryam suvānā devāsa indavaḥ
english: May those Indu-drops, the divine, when pressed, flow purified for us with rain from heaven and with heroic strength.

sanskrit: pavate haryato harir gṛṇāno jamadagninā hinvāno gor adhi tvaci
english: The lovely tawny one flows purified, praised by Jamadagni, being urged on upon the cow's skin.

sanskrit: pra śukrāso vayojuvo hinvānāso na saptayaḥ śrīṇānā apsu mṛñjata
english: The bright, life-giving drops, urged on like steeds, being mingled, cleanse themselves in the waters.

sanskrit: taṁ tvā suteṣv ābhuvo hinvire devatātaye sa pavasvānayā rucā
english: The powers present in the pressed draughts urge thee on for the service of the gods; flow purified with this radiance.

sanskrit: ā te dakṣam mayobhuvaṁ vahnim adyā vṛṇīmahe pāntam ā puruspṛham
english: Today we choose thy power that brings happiness, the carrier that is guarded, the much-longed-for one.

sanskrit: ā mandram ā vareṇyam ā vipram ā manīṣiṇam pāntam ā puruspṛham
english: The joyful, the excellent, the inspired, the wise, the guarded, the much-longed-for one we choose.

sanskrit: ā rayim ā sucetunam ā sukrato tanūṣv ā pāntam ā puruspṛham
english: Wealth, clear consciousness, O excellent in purpose, within our own persons — the guarded, much-longed-for one we choose.

sanskrit: pavasva viśvacarṣaṇe 'bhi viśvāni kāvyā sakhā sakhibhya īḍyaḥ
english: Flow purified, O thou who art seen by all, encompassing all poetic wisdom; thou art a friend to be praised by friends.

sanskrit: tābhyāṁ viśvasya rājasi ye pavamāna dhāmanī pratīcī soma tasthatuḥ
english: By those two dwelling-places of thine that stand facing, O Pavamāna, O Soma, thou reignest over the universe.

sanskrit: pari dhāmāni yāni te tvaṁ somāsi viśvataḥ pavamāna ṛtubhiḥ kave
english: Around thy dwelling-places, O Soma thou art from all sides, O Pavamāna, O sage, with the seasons.

sanskrit: pavasva janayann iṣo 'bhi viśvāni vāryā sakhā sakhibhya ūtaye
english: Flow purified, generating nourishments, encompassing all desirable things; be a friend to friends as an aid.

sanskrit: tava śukrāso arcayo divas pṛṣṭhe vi tanvate pavitraṁ soma dhāmabhiḥ
english: Thy bright rays spread the filter on the back of heaven, O Soma, with thy dwelling-places.

sanskrit: taveme sapta sindhavaḥ praśiṣaṁ soma sisrate tubhyaṁ dhāvanti dhenavaḥ
english: These seven rivers flow at thy command, O Soma; the milch-cows run to thee.

sanskrit: pra soma yāhi dhārayā suta indrāya matsaraḥ dadhāno akṣiti śravaḥ
english: Go forth, O Soma, with thy stream, pressed and exhilarating for Indra, bearing imperishable glory.

sanskrit: sam u tvā dhībhir asvaran hinvatīḥ sapta jāmayaḥ vipram ājā vivasvataḥ
english: The seven sister-streams have rung out together for thee with thoughts that urge thee, the inspired one born of Vivasvat.

sanskrit: mṛjanti tvā sam agruvo 'vye jīrāv adhi ṣvaṇi rebho yad ajyase vane
english: The assembled ones cleanse thee together on the swift woollen strainer as thou art rubbed in the wood, O singer.

sanskrit: pavamānasya te kave vājin sargā asṛkṣata arvanto na śravasyavaḥ
english: O sage, O prize-winner Pavamāna, thy currents have been poured, like steeds eager for glory.

sanskrit: acchā kośam madhuścutam asṛgraṁ vāre avyaye avāvaśanta dhītayaḥ
english: Toward the honey-dripping vessel the prayers have bellowed out; the drops were poured into the undying woollen filter.

sanskrit: acchā samudram indavo 'staṁ gāvo na dhenavaḥ agmann ṛtasya yonim ā
english: Toward the ocean the Indu-drops, like milch-cows going home, have entered the womb of truth.

sanskrit: pra ṇa indo mahe raṇa āpo arṣanti sindhavaḥ yad gobhir vāsayiṣyase
english: For us, O Indu, in the great exhilaration, the waters flow like rivers when thou wilt clothe thyself with the rays of cattle.

sanskrit: asya te sakhye vayam iyakṣantas tvotayaḥ indo sakhitvam uśmasi
english: We, longing to serve in this thy friendship, aided by thee, O Indu, desire thy companionship.

sanskrit: ā pavasva gaviṣṭaye mahe soma nṛcakṣase endrasya jaṭhare viśa
english: Flow purified for the winning of cattle, O great Soma, O thou seen by heroes; enter the belly of Indra.

sanskrit: mahām asi soma jyeṣṭha ugrāṇām inda ojiṣṭhaḥ yudhvā sañ chaśvaj jigetha
english: Thou art great, O Soma, foremost among the mighty, O Indu, the most powerful; being a fighter thou hast conquered ever and again.

sanskrit: ya ugrebhyaś cid ojīyāñ chūrebhyaś cic chūrataraḥ bhūridābhyaś cin maṁhīyān
english: He who is mightier even than the mighty, more heroic even than heroes, more bountiful even than the greatly giving.

sanskrit: tvaṁ soma sūra eṣas tokasya sātā tanūnām vṛṇīmahe sakhyāya vṛṇīmahe yujyāya
english: Thou, O Soma, art that sun for winning progeny and persons; we choose thee for friendship, we choose thee for fellowship.

sanskrit: agna āyūṁṣi pavasa ā suvorjam iṣaṁ ca naḥ āre bādhasva ducchunām
english: O Agni, flowing pure, bestow upon us lives and vigour and nourishment; repel misfortune far from us.

sanskrit: agnir ṛṣiḥ pavamānaḥ pāñcajanyaḥ purohitaḥ tam īmahe mahāgayam
english: Agni is the seer, Pavamāna, the household priest of the five peoples; we implore him who grants great wealth.

sanskrit: agne pavasva svapā asme varcaḥ suvīryam dadhad rayim mayi poṣam
english: O Agni, flow purified, O excellent worker; bestow upon us brightness and heroic strength, placing wealth and prosperity in me.

sanskrit: pavamāno ati sridho 'bhy arṣati suṣṭutim sūro na viśvadarśataḥ
english: Pavamāna flows over all foes toward excellent praise, like the sun, beautiful to all.

sanskrit: sa marmṛjāna āyubhiḥ prayasvān prayase hitaḥ indur atyo vicakṣaṇaḥ
english: He, the Indu, being well-cleansed by the living ones, lavish of oblations, devoted to offering, the swift, the clear-sighted.

sanskrit: pavamāna ṛtam bṛhac chukraṁ jyotir ajījanat kṛṣṇā tamāṁsi jaṅghanat
english: Pavamāna has generated the great truth, the bright light; he has struck down the black darknesses.

sanskrit: pavamānasya jaṅghnato hareś candrā asṛkṣata jīrā ajiraśociṣaḥ
english: From Pavamāna the striking tawny one, brilliant swift streams have been poured, gleaming with swift radiance.

sanskrit: pavamāno rathītamaḥ śubhrebhiḥ śubhraśastamaḥ hariścandro marudgaṇaḥ
english: Pavamāna is the best charioteer, most beautifully praised by the bright ones, tawny and brilliant, having the Marut hosts.

sanskrit: pavamāno vy aśnavad raśmibhir vājasātamaḥ dadhat stotre suvīryam
english: Pavamāna has pervaded with his rays, most winning of prizes, bestowing heroic might upon the praiser.

sanskrit: pra suvāna indur akṣāḥ pavitram aty avyayam punāna indur indram ā
english: The pressed Indu, the axle, has flowed beyond the undying filter; Indu, purifying himself, goes to Indra.

sanskrit: eṣa somo adhi tvaci gavāṁ krīḻaty adribhiḥ indram madāya johuvat
english: This Soma sports upon the skin of the cows with the stones, calling upon Indra for exhilaration.

sanskrit: yasya te dyumnavat payaḥ pavamānābhṛtaṁ divaḥ tena no mṛḻa jīvase
english: With that bright milk of thine, O Pavamāna, brought from heaven, be gracious to us that we may live.

sanskrit: tvaṁ somāsi dhārayur mandra ojiṣṭho adhvare pavasva maṁhayadrayiḥ
english: Thou, O Soma, art the sustainer, joyful, most mighty at the sacrifice; flow purified, thou who givest wealth freely.

sanskrit: tvaṁ suto nṛmādano dadhanvān matsarintamaḥ indrāya sūrir andhasā
english: Thou, pressed out, gladdening men, most swift-running, most exhilarating, art the wise one for Indra with thy food.

sanskrit: tvaṁ suṣvāṇo adribhir abhy arṣa kanikradat dyumantaṁ śuṣmam uttamam
english: Thou, well-pressed by the stones, flow forth bellowing with thy loftiest brilliant vigour.

sanskrit: indur hinvāno arṣati tiro vārāṇy avyayā harir vājam acikradat
english: Indu, being urged on, flows through the undying woollen strainers; the tawny one has bellowed for the prize.

sanskrit: indo vy avyam arṣasi vi śravāṁsi vi saubhagā vi vājān soma gomataḥ
english: O Indu, thou flowest through the wool, through glories, through prosperities; O Soma, through prizes rich in cattle.

sanskrit: ā na indo śatagvinaṁ rayiṁ gomantam aśvinam bharā soma sahasriṇam
english: Bring to us, O Indu, O Soma, wealth of a hundred kinds rich in kine and horses, thousandfold.

sanskrit: pavamānāsa indavas tiraḥ pavitram āśavaḥ indraṁ yāmebhir āśata
english: The swift Pavamāna Indus, through the filter, have reached Indra with their courses.

sanskrit: kakuhaḥ somyo rasa indur indrāya pūrvyaḥ āyuḥ pavata āyave
english: The eminent Soma-juice, Indu the ancient, flows purified for Indra; life flows for the living.

sanskrit: hinvanti sūram usrayaḥ pavamānam madhuścutam abhi girā sam asvaran
english: The dawn-rays urge on the honey-dripping Pavamāna; they have sung together with their hymn.

sanskrit: avitā no ajāśvaḥ pūṣā yāmani-yāmani ā bhakṣat kanyāsu naḥ
english: May Pūṣan, the protector with his goat-team, at every journey, partake of the Soma-drink among our maidens.

sanskrit: ayaṁ somaḥ kapardine ghṛtaṁ na pavate madhu ā bhakṣat kanyāsu naḥ
english: This Soma flows like ghee, sweet, for Rudra with his braided hair; may he partake among our maidens.

sanskrit: ayaṁ ta āghṛṇe suto ghṛtaṁ na pavate śuci ā bhakṣat kanyāsu naḥ
english: This pressed juice of thine, O radiant one, flows purified like ghee; may he partake among our maidens.

sanskrit: vāco jantuḥ kavīnām pavasva soma dhārayā deveṣu ratnadhā asi
english: Thou art the source of the utterances of the seers; flow, O Soma, with thy stream; among the gods thou art the bestower of treasure.

sanskrit: ā kalaśeṣu dhāvati śyeno varma vi gāhate abhi droṇā kanikradat
english: He runs into the vessels, like a hawk cleaving through the armour, bellowing over the troughs.

sanskrit: pari pra soma te raso 'sarji kalaśe sutaḥ śyeno na takto arṣati
english: Around and forth thy juice, O Soma, pressed out, has been released into the vessel; like a hawk that is rubbed clean, he flows.

sanskrit: pavasva soma mandayann indrāya madhumattamaḥ
english: Flow purified, O Soma, gladdening, most honey-sweet, for Indra.

sanskrit: asṛgran devavītaye vājayanto rathā iva
english: They have been poured for the delight of gods, striving for prizes like chariots.

sanskrit: te sutāso madintamāḥ śukrā vāyum asṛkṣata
english: Those pressed drops, most exhilarating, bright, have been poured for Vāyu.

sanskrit: grāvṇā tunno abhiṣṭutaḥ pavitraṁ soma gacchasi dadhat stotre suvīryam
english: Struck by the pressing-stone, praised on all sides, O Soma, thou goest to the filter, bestowing heroic might upon the praiser.

sanskrit: eṣa tunno abhiṣṭutaḥ pavitram ati gāhate rakṣohā vāram avyayam
english: This one, struck and praised on all sides, plunges through the filter, the demon-slayer through the undying woollen strainer.

sanskrit: yad anti yac ca dūrake bhayaṁ vindati mām iha pavamāna vi taj jahi
english: Whatever fear finds me here, whether near or far, O Pavamāna, strike that away.

sanskrit: pavamānaḥ so adya naḥ pavitreṇa vicarṣaṇiḥ yaḥ potā sa punātu naḥ
english: May that Pavamāna, the all-seeing, today purify us with the filter; he who is the Potr-priest, may he purify us.

sanskrit: yat te pavitram arciṣy agne vitatam antar ā brahma tena punīhi naḥ
english: With that filter of thine, O Agni, which is spread within thy flame, with that brahman-prayer purify us.

sanskrit: yat te pavitram arcivad agne tena punīhi naḥ brahmasavaiḥ punīhi naḥ
english: With that filter of thine, O Agni, that is bright as flame, purify us; with thy sacred stimulations purify us.

sanskrit: ubhābhyāṁ deva savitaḥ pavitreṇa savena ca mām punīhi viśvataḥ
english: O god Savitṛ, with both the filter and the divine impulse, purify me on all sides.

sanskrit: tribhiṣ ṭvaṁ deva savitar varṣiṣṭhaiḥ soma dhāmabhiḥ agne dakṣaiḥ punīhi naḥ
english: O god Savitṛ, purify us with thy three highest Soma-dwelling-places; O Agni, purify us with thy powers.

sanskrit: punantu māṁ devajanāḥ punantu vasavo dhiyā viśve devāḥ punīta mā jātavedaḥ punīhi mā
english: May the divine folk purify me; may the Vasus purify me with thought; O all ye gods, purify me; O Jātavedas, purify me.

sanskrit: pra pyāyasva pra syandasva soma viśvebhir aṁśubhiḥ devebhya uttamaṁ haviḥ
english: Swell forth, flow forth, O Soma, with all thy shoots; thou art the highest oblation for the gods.

sanskrit: upa priyam panipnataṁ yuvānam āhutīvṛdham aganma bibhrato namaḥ
english: We have come to the dear, glittering youth who grows great with oblations, bearing him reverence.

sanskrit: alāyyasya paraśur nanāśa tam ā pavasva deva soma ākhuṁ cid eva deva soma
english: The axe of the Alāyya has perished — cleanse away that, O divine Soma; even the rat's mischief, O divine Soma.

sanskrit: yaḥ pāvamānīr adhyety ṛṣibhiḥ sambhṛtaṁ rasam sarvaṁ sa pūtam aśnāti svaditam mātariśvanā
english: Whoever reads through the Pāvamānī hymns — the juice assembled by the seers — all of it he eats purified and made savory by Mātariśvan.

sanskrit: pāvamānīr yo adhyety ṛṣibhiḥ sambhṛtaṁ rasam tasmai sarasvatī duhe kṣīraṁ sarpir madhūdakam
english: Whoever reads through the Pāvamānī hymns — the juice assembled by the seers — for him Sarasvatī milks out milk, clarified butter, and honeyed water.

sanskrit: pra devam acchā madhumanta indavo 'siṣyadanta gāva ā na dhenavaḥ barhiṣado vacanāvanta ūdhabhiḥ parisrutam usriyā nirṇijaṁ dhire
english: Toward the god, the honey-laden Indu-drops have hissed forth; the cows have come to us like milch-cows; seated on the sacred grass, endowed with utterance, the dawn-cows have set in order the filtered stream with their udders as its lustrous garment.

sanskrit: sa roruvad abhi pūrvā acikradad upāruhaḥ śrathayan svādate hariḥ tiraḥ pavitram pariyann uru jrayo ni śaryāṇi dadhate deva ā varam
english: He, bellowing, cried out over the former ones; mounting up, the tawny one sounding sweet loosens himself; moving around through the filter, covering vast extents, the god lays down the shaft-wounds and chooses the best.

sanskrit: vi yo mame yamyā saṁyatī madaḥ sākaṁvṛdhā payasā pinvad akṣitā mahī apāre rajasī vivevidad abhivrajann akṣitam pāja ā dade
english: He who measures out, though twin-born, the exhilaration when the two flow together, swelling with milk that grows together and is imperishable — he who knows widely the two great, boundless firmaments, striding forward, has taken up the imperishable vigour.

sanskrit: sa mātarā vicaran vājayann apaḥ pra medhiraḥ svadhayā pinvate padam aṁśur yavena pipiśe yato nṛbhiḥ saṁ jāmibhir nasate rakṣate śiraḥ
english: He, roaming between the two mothers, making the waters prize-winning, the wise one swells his track by his own power; the stalk adorned with grain, directed by men, reaches together with his own kindred and guards the head.

sanskrit: saṁ dakṣeṇa manasā jāyate kavir ṛtasya garbho nihito yamā paraḥ yūnā ha santā prathamaṁ vi jajñatur guhā hitaṁ janima nemam udyatam
english: With energy and thought the sage is born, the embryo of truth placed beyond the twins; though both being young, they first knew each other — the birth hidden in the secret place is not this one uplifted here.

sanskrit: mandrasya rūpaṁ vividur manīṣiṇaḥ śyeno yad andho abharat parāvataḥ tam marjayanta suvṛdhaṁ nadīṣv ām uśantam aṁśum pariyantam ṛgmiyam
english: The wise ones have recognised the form of the joyful one, when the falcon brought the food from afar; him they cleanse — the stalk that grows well in the rivers, that is eager and hymn-worthy, moving around.

sanskrit: tvām mṛjanti daśa yoṣaṇaḥ sutaṁ soma ṛṣibhir matibhir dhītibhir hitam avyo vārebhir uta devahūtibhir nṛbhir yato vājam ā darṣi sātaye
english: The ten maidens cleanse thee, O Soma, pressed out, set in place by seers with their thoughts and insights, both with woollen strainers and with divine invocations; directed by men, thou shalt burst forth the prize for the winning.

sanskrit: pariprayantaṁ vayyaṁ suṣaṁsadaṁ somam manīṣā abhy anūṣata stubhaḥ yo dhārayā madhumām ūrmiṇā diva iyarti vācaṁ rayiṣāḻ amartyaḥ
english: The sacred utterances have sung beside Soma who moves around pervasively, well-seated and fitting to be borne — he who with his stream, his honey-sweet wave from heaven, the immortal one rich in wealth, sets the hymn in motion.

sanskrit: ayaṁ diva iyarti viśvam ā rajaḥ somaḥ punānaḥ kalaśeṣu sīdati adbhir gobhir mṛjyate adribhiḥ sutaḥ punāna indur varivo vidat priyam
english: This Soma sets the whole firmament in motion from heaven, purifying himself, he settles in the vessels; pressed and cleansed with waters, cows, and stones, the Indu purifying himself shall find wide space and the beloved.

sanskrit: evā naḥ soma pariṣicyamāno vayo dadhac citratamam pavasva adveṣe dyāvāpṛthivī huvema devā dhatta rayim asme suvīram
english: Even thus, O Soma, as thou art poured around, flow purified, bestowing most wonderful vigour upon us; without hostility may we invoke Heaven and Earth; O gods, bestow upon us wealth with heroic sons.

sanskrit: iṣur na dhanvan prati dhīyate matir vatso na mātur upa sarjy ūdhani urudhāreva duhe agra āyaty asya vrateṣv api soma iṣyate
english: As an arrow is set to the bow, as a calf is loosed to the mother's udder, so thought is set in place; like a wide-flowing one it is milked when it comes at the beginning; in his rites Soma too is set in motion.

sanskrit: upo matiḥ pṛcyate sicyate madhu mandrājanī codate antar āsani pavamānaḥ saṁtaniḥ praghnatām iva madhumān drapsaḥ pari vāram arṣati
english: To it thought is mingled, the sweet drink is poured, the joyful, life-giving one is set in motion from within the seat; Pavamāna the continuous one, the honey-sweet drop like one who crushes the host, flows around the strainer.

sanskrit: avye vadhūyuḥ pavate pari tvaci śrathnīte naptīr aditer ṛtaṁ yate harir akrān yajataḥ saṁyato mado nṛmṇā śiśāno mahiṣo na śobhate
english: He who seeks his bride flows purified over the skin of the sheep; the granddaughters of Aditi loosen themselves when truth is set in motion; the tawny worshipful one has strode forward; the exhilaration, contained and whetting his manly power, shines like a great bull.

sanskrit: ukṣā mimāti prati yanti dhenavo devasya devīr upa yanti niṣkṛtam aty akramīd arjunaṁ vāram avyayam atkaṁ na niktam pari somo avyata
english: The bull lows; the milch-cows go toward him; the divine females of the god approach his place of purification; Soma has stepped over the white undying woollen strainer, wrapping himself around it like a garment being washed.

sanskrit: amṛktena ruśatā vāsasā harir amartyo nirṇijānaḥ pari vyata divas pṛṣṭham barhaṇā nirṇije kṛtopastaraṇaṁ camvor nabhasmayam
english: With his unspotted, gleaming garment, the immortal tawny one, displaying his lustrous robe, wraps himself around; the back of heaven, prepared as a strewing for his bright garment, is the misty bottom of the bowls.

sanskrit: sūryasyeva raśmayo drāvayitnavo matsarāsaḥ prasupaḥ sākam īrate tantuṁ tatam pari sargāsa āśavo nendrād ṛte pavate dhāma kiṁ cana
english: Like rays of the sun, the exhilarating, well-running drops move in company about the stretched thread; the swift currents flow around it — without Indra, not a single ordinance is purified.

sanskrit: sindhor iva pravaṇe nimna āśavo vṛṣacyutā madāso gātum āśata śaṁ no niveśe dvipade catuṣpade 'sme vājāḥ soma tiṣṭhantu kṛṣṭayaḥ
english: Like swift ones in the descent of a river, the exhilarations poured by the bull from the deep have entered their path; be there welfare for us in the dwelling of bipeds and quadrupeds; O Soma, may prizes and cultivated fields stand firm for us.

sanskrit: ā naḥ pavasva vasumad dhiraṇyavad aśvāvad gomad yavamat suvīryam yūyaṁ hi soma pitaro mama sthana divo mūrdhānaḥ prasthitā vayaskṛtaḥ
english: Flow to us with wealth, with gold, with horses, with cattle, with grain, with heroic strength; for you are indeed, O Soma, my fathers — the heads of heaven, come forth bestowing vigour.

sanskrit: ete somāḥ pavamānāsa indraṁ rathā iva pra yayuḥ sātim accha sutāḥ pavitram ati yanty avyaṁ hitvī vavriṁ harito vṛṣṭim accha
english: These Pavamāna Soma-drops, when pressed, have gone like chariots toward Indra for the winning; they pass beyond the woollen filter, the tawny ones abandoning the covering go toward the rain.

sanskrit: indav indrāya bṛhate pavasva sumṛḻīko anavadyo riśādāḥ bharā candrāṇi gṛṇate vasūni devair dyāvāpṛthivī prāvataṁ naḥ
english: O Indu, flow purified for great Indra, bountiful, blameless, devouring rivals; bring shining riches for the praiser; O gods, may Heaven and Earth protect us.

sanskrit: trir asmai sapta dhenavo duduhre satyām āśiram pūrvye vyomani catvāry anyā bhuvanāni nirṇije cārūṇi cakre yad ṛtair avardhata
english: Thrice the seven milch-cows milked for him the true mixed drink in the primeval sky; he made the other four worlds beautiful as his lustrous garment when he grew great through the laws of truth.

sanskrit: sa bhikṣamāṇo amṛtasya cāruṇa ubhe dyāvā kāvyenā vi śaśrathe tejiṣṭhā apo maṁhanā pari vyata yadī devasya śravasā sado viduḥ
english: He who begs for the beautiful immortality has split apart both heavens with his poetic power; he wraps himself around the sharpest waters with bounty — when they know the dwelling of the divine one by his fame.

sanskrit: te asya santu ketavo 'mṛtyavo 'dābhyāso januṣī ubhe anu yebhir nṛmṇā ca devyā ca punata ād id rājānam mananā agṛbhṇata
english: May his tokens be immortal, undeceivable, following along both births; with which they purify both manly power and the divine, and with their thoughts they have grasped the king thereafter.

sanskrit: sa mṛjyamāno daśabhiḥ sukarmabhiḥ pra madhyamāsu mātṛṣu prame sacā vratāni pāno amṛtasya cāruṇa ubhe nṛcakṣā anu paśyate viśau
english: Being cleansed by ten well-working ones, he runs forward, accompanying them among the middle mothers at the first station; he who has drunk of the beautiful immortality, the hero-seer, surveys both the wide expanses.

sanskrit: sa marmṛjāna indriyāya dhāyasa obhe antā rodasī harṣate hitaḥ vṛṣā śuṣmeṇa bādhate vi durmatīr ādediśānaḥ śaryaheva śurudhaḥ
english: Being well-cleansed for Indra's power and for nourishment, he, placed in his seat, rejoices toward both ends of Heaven and Earth; the vigorous bull with his vigour drives away evil thoughts, directing them apart like a bowman driving forth his arrows.

sanskrit: sa mātarā na dadṛśāna usriyo nānadad eti marutām iva svanaḥ jānann ṛtam prathamaṁ yat svarṇaram praśastaye kam avṛṇīta sukratuḥ
english: He, the bright one, going without seeing his two mothers, roars as he goes like the sound of the Maruts; knowing the truth, what was at first the sunlit way, the one of excellent purpose has chosen it for his own glory.

sanskrit: ruvati bhīmo vṛṣabhas taviṣyayā śṛṅge śiśāno hariṇī vicakṣaṇaḥ ā yoniṁ somaḥ sukṛtaṁ ni ṣīdati gavyayī tvag bhavati nirṇig avyayī
english: The terrible bull roars with his strength, sharpening his two horns, the clear-sighted tawny one; Soma the well-made sits down in his seat — the cow-skin becomes his bright garment, the woollen fleece his lustrous vesture.

sanskrit: śuciḥ punānas tanvam arepasam avye harir ny adhāviṣṭa sānavi juṣṭo mitrāya varuṇāya vāyave tridhātu madhu kriyate sukarmabhiḥ
english: The pure one, purifying his spotless body, the tawny one has run down upon the ridge of the fleece; beloved by Mitra, Varuṇa, and Vāyu, the threefold sweet drink is made by the well-working ones.

sanskrit: pavasva soma devavītaye vṛṣendrasya hārdi somadhānam ā viśa purā no bādhād duritāti pāraya kṣetravid dhi diśa āhā vipṛcchate
english: Flow pure, O Soma, for the delight of gods, O vigorous bull; enter the soma-vessel that is the heart of Indra; before adversity presses upon us carry us across the evil; for the knower of the field declares the directions to him who asks.

sanskrit: hito na saptir abhi vājam arṣendrasyendo jaṭharam ā pavasva nāvā na sindhum ati parṣi vidvāñ chūro na yudhyann ava no nidaḥ spaḥ
english: Like a harnessed steed flow toward the prize, O Indu; flow purified into the belly of Indra; like a ship carry us across the flood, O knowing one; like a hero fighting, strike down those who blame us.
